## tabula

```text
package tabula // import "github.com/0xJean/tabula"

Package tabula is a zero-dependency, descriptor-driven single-table SQL engine
for PostgreSQL. A row struct carries lightweight `db` tags; Define validates
the declaration once at package initialization, derives static parameterized
statements and column privilege needs, and records them in a Registry for
verification (PREPARE/EXPLAIN, schema checks, SQL snapshots).

Host applications inject their own scope type S (e.g. a tenant scope or
struct{}), value converters, and error classification via RegistryConfig so this
package stays decoupled from any application domain or error taxonomy.

CONSTANTS

const (
	// ErrCallbackContext means a live runner handle received a context that
	// does not belong to its callback when RequireCallbackContext is enabled.
	ErrCallbackContext staticError = "context does not belong to this session callback"

	// ErrCommit marks an error returned by a runner's top-level Commit call.
	// A lost acknowledgement can leave the outcome unknown. The underlying
	// driver error and SQLSTATE remain available to determine a known rejection.
	ErrCommit staticError = "transaction commit failed (outcome may be unknown)"

	// Write-guard and optimistic concurrency sentinel errors (used when
	// ErrorPolicy leaves the corresponding slot nil).
	ErrConflict           staticError = "row conflict or lost update"
	ErrOnce               staticError = "insert-only column changed on update"
	ErrNotDeleted         staticError = "soft delete needs the deleted column set"
	ErrRowCount           staticError = "write did not confirm exactly one row"
	ErrReadOnly           staticError = "operation requires a writable session and table"
	ErrScopeMismatch      staticError = "row scope differs from the bound session"
	ErrForbiddenStatement staticError = "statement attempts to modify session role or configuration"
	ErrForeignSession     staticError = "session was not issued for this registry"
	ErrNested             staticError = "nested transaction is not allowed"
	ErrSessionClosed      staticError = "session is closed"
	ErrCapabilityDenied   staticError = "operation denied by registry capability policy"

	// ErrOperationDenied means the table declaration forbids an operation or column,
	// including legacy Rows methods on a source declared with DefinePlanSource.
	ErrOperationDenied staticError = "operation denied by table write mode"

	// ErrUnscopedRequiresReadOnly reports that UnscopedReadOnly denied access
	// because the transaction is read-write and no shared reader role applies.
	// It also matches ErrReadOnly.
	ErrUnscopedRequiresReadOnly readOnlyPolicyError = "UnscopedReadOnly requires a read-only transaction"

	// ErrSessionBusy reports an overlapping operation on a transaction.
	// Finish the active statement or row iteration before using the transaction again.
	ErrSessionBusy staticError = "another operation is using the transaction"

	// PostgreSQL error-class sentinels returned by default error classification.
	ErrUnique                staticError = "unique constraint violation"
	ErrForeignKey            staticError = "foreign key constraint violation"
	ErrCheck                 staticError = "check constraint violation"
	ErrNotNull               staticError = "not-null constraint violation"
	ErrSerialization         staticError = "serialization failure"
	ErrDeadlock              staticError = "deadlock detected"
	ErrRLSDenied             staticError = "row-level security policy denied the operation"
	ErrInsufficientPrivilege staticError = "insufficient PostgreSQL privilege"
	ErrCanceled              staticError = "statement canceled"
)
const ErrLegacySQL legacySQLDenial = "tabula: this operation requires a registered statement"
    ErrLegacySQL means the operation needs hand-written SQL or a shape that has
    not been registered. It also matches ErrCapabilityDenied.

const ErrStatementAuthority staticError = "tabula: statement authority or session does not match"
    ErrStatementAuthority reports an unregistered call, a different registry's
    credential, or a call delivered to a different session.


FUNCTIONS

func Avg[V, T, K, S any](ctx context.Context, rows *Rows[T, K, S], col string, where func(*Filter)) (V, bool, error)
    Avg evaluates SELECT AVG(col) over live rows matching the session scope and
    where filter. See Max for NULL semantics and result-type selection.

func BindCallbackContext(ctx context.Context) (context.Context, func(context.Context) error)
    BindCallbackContext marks a new runner callback and returns a check for its
    context and descendants. The check returns ErrCallbackContext for unrelated
    or detached contexts. It retains only the private identity.

func CountBy[V comparable, T, K, S any](ctx context.Context, rows *Rows[T, K, S], col string, where func(*Filter)) (map[V]int64, error)
    CountBy evaluates SELECT col, count(*) ... GROUP BY col over live rows
    matching the session scope and where filter. col must be declared on the
    table and whitelisted in TableSpec.GroupBy. An empty result returns a
    non-nil empty map. Grouping keys must be non-null.

func GuardNoSessionEscape(query string) error
    GuardNoSessionEscape rejects role and session-authorization changes,
    RESET ALL, DISCARD ALL, transaction-ending commands (COMMIT, END, ABORT,
    non-savepoint ROLLBACK, PREPARE TRANSACTION), updates to pg_settings,
    and calls to set_config. It checks each statement and rejects anonymous
    DO blocks and Unicode-escaped identifiers. Ordinary quoted identifiers,
    literals and comments follow PostgreSQL token boundaries.

    Pass it directly to stdsql.ScopePolicy.GuardQuery or
    pgxdriver.ScopePolicy.GuardQuery.

func GuardReadOnly(query string) error
    GuardReadOnly admits a single SELECT or WITH statement and applies
    GuardNoSessionEscape. Adapters must also use a read-only PostgreSQL
    connection to enforce write restrictions inside CTEs and functions.

func GuardReadOnlyTransaction(query string) error
    GuardReadOnlyTransaction keeps transaction control with the runner.
    It returns an error matching both ErrReadOnly and ErrForbiddenStatement
    for transaction-ending commands, SET TRANSACTION, updates to pg_settings,
    and changes to transaction_read_only or default_transaction_read_only.
    Calls to set_config require a literal unprotected key. Savepoints remain
    available. Use it with an established PostgreSQL READ ONLY transaction to
    enforce access inside functions and other indirect SQL.

func GuardSingleStatement(query string) error
    GuardSingleStatement admits one SELECT, VALUES, TABLE, INSERT, UPDATE,
    DELETE, MERGE or WITH in UTF-8 SQL, optionally terminated by a semicolon.
    It rejects incomplete lexical boundaries and ordinary string quote escapes
    whose interpretation depends on connection settings. Use bind parameters or
    explicit E strings for those values. PostgreSQL validates the grammar and
    authorizes data and function access.

func InTransaction(ctx context.Context) bool
    InTransaction reports whether ctx carries an active transaction marker from
    MarkTransaction (and has not been detached with WithoutTransaction).

func IsCheckViolation(err error) bool
    IsCheckViolation reports PostgreSQL check_violation (SQLSTATE 23514).

func IsDeadlock(err error) bool
    IsDeadlock reports PostgreSQL deadlock_detected (SQLSTATE 40P01).

func IsForeignKeyViolation(err error) bool
    IsForeignKeyViolation reports PostgreSQL foreign_key_violation (SQLSTATE
    23503).

func IsNotNullViolation(err error) bool
    IsNotNullViolation reports PostgreSQL not_null_violation (SQLSTATE 23502).

func IsNumericOutOfRange(err error) bool
    IsNumericOutOfRange reports SQLSTATE 22003.

func IsQueryCanceled(err error) bool
    IsQueryCanceled reports PostgreSQL query_canceled (SQLSTATE 57014).

func IsRejectedValue(err error) bool
    IsRejectedValue reports a value refused by column definitions: string data
    right truncation (22001), numeric value out of range (22003), not_null
    violation (23502), check violation (23514), or invalid text representation
    (22P02).

func IsRetryable(err error) bool
    IsRetryable reports whether err is a PostgreSQL serialization failure
    (SQLSTATE 40001 / ErrSerialization) or deadlock (SQLSTATE 40P01 /
    ErrDeadlock).

func IsSerializationFailure(err error) bool
    IsSerializationFailure reports PostgreSQL serialization_failure (SQLSTATE
    40001).

func IsUniqueViolation(err error) bool
    IsUniqueViolation reports PostgreSQL unique_violation (SQLSTATE 23505).

func JSON(p any) any
    JSON addresses a json/jsonb column held as any Go value (text in and out).
    NULL reads as the zero value; a nil pointer value writes NULL.

func MarkTransaction(ctx context.Context) context.Context
    MarkTransaction marks ctx as running inside an active runner transaction so
    nested runner entries (across both stdsql and pgxdriver) fail closed with
    ErrNested before BEGIN.

func Max[V, T, K, S any](ctx context.Context, rows *Rows[T, K, S], col string, where func(*Filter)) (V, bool, error)
    Max evaluates SELECT MAX(col) over live rows matching the session scope and
    where filter. Choose V for PostgreSQL's result type; registered registry
    codecs are reused automatically. SQL NULL (empty set or all NULL values)
    returns (zero, false, nil); a genuine zero returns (zero, true, nil).

func Min[V, T, K, S any](ctx context.Context, rows *Rows[T, K, S], col string, where func(*Filter)) (V, bool, error)
    Min evaluates SELECT MIN(col) over live rows matching the session scope and
    where filter. See Max for NULL semantics and result-type selection.

func NewSessionGuard(cfg SessionGuardConfig) (func(string) error, error)
    NewSessionGuard compiles an application GuardQuery for trusted adapter SQL.
    RESET ALL, DISCARD ALL, and transaction-ending commands (COMMIT, END,
    ABORT, non-savepoint ROLLBACK, PREPARE TRANSACTION) are rejected whenever
    the guard protects role, session-authorization, or variable state. Any
    active restriction rejects anonymous DO blocks, Unicode-escaped identifiers
    and UPDATE of pg_settings, which PostgreSQL applies as SET. A zero config
    permits all statements.

func RegisterType[S, V any](r *Registry[S], wrap func(*V) any)
    RegisterType registers a converter wrapping a pointer to a value of type T.
    Call during initialization before Define.

func RegisterZero[S, V any](r *Registry[S])
    RegisterZero registers scalar type V for the ",zero" db tag option (NULL
    scans as V's zero value; writes bind V directly).

func Retry(ctx context.Context, cfg RetryConfig, fn func(context.Context) error) error
    Retry invokes fn up to cfg.MaxAttempts times while fn returns a retryable
    error and ctx has not been canceled.

func SQLAction(query string) string
    SQLAction infers a low-cardinality verb label from query for inline SQL
    telemetry ("select", "insert", "update", "delete", "merge", "with",
    or "sql").

func SQLFingerprint(query string) string
    SQLFingerprint returns a stable 12-character hex fingerprint of normalized
    PostgreSQL text. Literal values, numeric constants and numbered parameters
    are replaced by "?" so argument values never enter the fingerprint.

func SQLState(err error) string
    SQLState returns the five-character PostgreSQL SQLSTATE carried by err
    (compatible with both lib/pq and pgx errors implementing SQLState() string),
    or "" when the code is absent or contains anything other than five ASCII
    digits and uppercase letters.

func Sum[V, T, K, S any](ctx context.Context, rows *Rows[T, K, S], col string, where func(*Filter)) (V, bool, error)
    Sum evaluates SELECT SUM(col) over live rows matching the session scope and
    where filter. See Max for NULL semantics and result-type selection.

func TagSQL(query, key string) string
    TagSQL prefixes query with a sanitized `/* tabula:<key> */ ` comment.

func WithStatementMeta(ctx context.Context, meta StatementMeta) context.Context
    WithStatementMeta attaches descriptor statement metadata to ctx for a
    session-level Observer to consume.

func WithoutTransaction(ctx context.Context) context.Context
    WithoutTransaction clears the transaction marker and callback ownership
    while preserving deadlines, cancellation, tracing spans and request
    metadata.

    Use this only when intentionally opening an independent transaction
    inside a runner callback (for example, an out-of-band audit record that
    must commit even if the outer transaction rolls back). Warning: opening a
    detached transaction checks out a second pooled connection while the outer
    transaction still holds one, which can deadlock a saturated connection pool.

func Zero[V any](p *V) any
    Zero addresses a nullable scalar column as a plain value of type V.


TYPES

type AdvisoryLock struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    AdvisoryLock declares a transaction-level PostgreSQL advisory operation.
    The bigint and two-integer key spaces are independent in PostgreSQL.

func AdvisoryXactLock(mode AdvisoryMode, wait LockWait, key Expr[int64]) AdvisoryLock
    AdvisoryXactLock uses a single bigint key. Wait blocks, Try returns false on
    contention. Both modes hold an acquired lock until transaction end.

func AdvisoryXactLockPair(mode AdvisoryMode, wait LockWait, first, second Expr[int32]) AdvisoryLock
    AdvisoryXactLockPair uses the separate PostgreSQL (integer, integer)
    overload.

type AdvisoryLockPlan[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    AdvisoryLockPlan acquires a registered advisory lock through an authorized
    transaction session. Its View owns the statement in the registry.

func DefineAdvisoryLock[T, S any](view *View[T, S], key string, lock AdvisoryLock) *AdvisoryLockPlan[T, S]
    DefineAdvisoryLock registers a transaction lock independently of any table
    access. The output view has one boolean column indicating acquisition.

func TryDefineAdvisoryLock[T, S any](view *View[T, S], key string, lock AdvisoryLock) (*AdvisoryLockPlan[T, S], error)
    TryDefineAdvisoryLock registers the complete operation or returns an error.

func (p *AdvisoryLockPlan[T, S]) Bind(s Session[S]) *BoundAdvisoryLockPlan[T, S]
    Bind attaches the advisory lock plan to a session from its registry.

type AdvisoryMode uint8
    AdvisoryMode selects an exclusive or shared transaction-level advisory lock.

const (
	Exclusive AdvisoryMode = iota + 1
	Shared
)
type Assignment struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Assignment is an atomic update constructed by Add or SetNow.

func Add[N number](column string, delta N) Assignment
    Add adds a bound numeric value to a column in PostgreSQL.

func SetNow(column string) Assignment
    SetNow assigns PostgreSQL's transaction timestamp, now(), to a column.

type AuthorizedSQL struct {
	Query, Key string
	Args       []any
	Effects    ShapeEffects
	// SecretArgs uses the same bind order as Args.
	SecretArgs []bool

	// Has unexported fields.
}
    AuthorizedSQL is the driver view of a successfully verified call. Its fields
    describe this call only. Editing the view cannot authorize SQL.

func (q AuthorizedSQL) ObservationContext(ctx context.Context) context.Context
    ObservationContext attaches the registered key and redaction policy before
    a driver starts observing the call. It preserves the descriptor's logger,
    scope label and treatment of empty results.

type AuthorizedSession interface {
	ExecAuthorized(context.Context, AuthorizedStatement) (int64, error)
	ScanAuthorized(context.Context, AuthorizedStatement, ...any) error
	EachAuthorized(context.Context, AuthorizedStatement, func(func(...any) error) error) error
}
    AuthorizedSession is the driver channel used for registered queries.
    Every entry verifies its AuthorizedStatement against the receiving session
    and applies the usual method, transaction and database guards.

type AuthorizedStatement struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    AuthorizedStatement is an opaque call bound to one registered shape, one
    session instance and its ordered parameters. Applications cannot construct
    it from SQL text, a snapshot or a verification credential.

func (c AuthorizedStatement) Method() CallMethod
    Method identifies the intended driver operation. The driver verifies it with
    Open before using the SQL or arguments.

type Binding struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Binding supplies the value of one Slot to an execution.

func BindValue[V any](slot Slot[V], value V) Binding
    BindValue pairs an input with a value of its declared Go type.

type BoundAdvisoryLockPlan[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    BoundAdvisoryLockPlan executes a transaction-level advisory lock on one
    session.

func (b *BoundAdvisoryLockPlan[T, S]) Acquire(ctx context.Context, args ...Binding) (bool, error)
    Acquire reports whether this transaction holds the requested lock. Wait
    returns true on success. Try returns false while another transaction holds a
    conflicting lock. Direct rejects both modes.

type BoundMutationPlan[T, S any] struct {
	rowExecution[T, S]
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    BoundMutationPlan executes one declared mutation family on an authorized
    session.

func (b *BoundMutationPlan[T, S]) DeleteMany(ctx context.Context, filters []string, values ...Binding) (int64, error)
    DeleteMany physically deletes matching live rows and returns the exact
    affected count.

func (b *BoundMutationPlan[T, S]) UpdateMany(ctx context.Context, set string, filters []string, values ...Binding) (int64, error)
    UpdateMany selects a complete named assignment set and returns the exact
    affected row count, including zero. The filter list selects optional
    predicates.

type BoundReadPlan[T, S any] struct{ rowExecution[T, S] }
    BoundReadPlan runs an explicit SELECT through the registry-authorized
    session.

func (b *BoundReadPlan[T, S]) Find(ctx context.Context, values ...Binding) ([]T, error)
    Find decodes all matching result rows. Each caller input must be bound once.

type BoundRoutinePlan[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    BoundRoutinePlan executes a registered function on one session.

func (b *BoundRoutinePlan[T, S]) All(ctx context.Context, args ...Binding) ([]T, error)
    All decodes every value of a RoutineSet call, including an empty result.

func (b *BoundRoutinePlan[T, S]) One(ctx context.Context, args ...Binding) (T, error)
    One decodes the single value of a RoutineOne call into the registered view.

type BoundRowsPlan[T, S any] struct {
	rowExecution[T, S]
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    BoundRowsPlan executes registered statements on one authorized session.

func (b *BoundRowsPlan[T, S]) Count(ctx context.Context, filters []string, values ...Binding) (int64, error)
    Count counts unpaged result rows (groups for grouped queries). Supply only
    the bindings used by the selected WHERE predicates. A locking plan returns
    ErrOperationDenied.

func (b *BoundRowsPlan[T, S]) Exists(ctx context.Context, filters []string, values ...Binding) (bool, error)
    Exists reports whether a visible row satisfies the selected filter. Declare
    WithExists to enable it. It ignores data-page ordering and bounds.

func (b *BoundRowsPlan[T, S]) Find(ctx context.Context, choice RowChoice, values ...Binding) ([]T, error)
    Find returns the selected data page. It executes one registered statement.

func (b *BoundRowsPlan[T, S]) List(ctx context.Context, choice RowChoice, values ...Binding) ([]T, int64, error)
    List returns a data page and the exact count before pagination.
    The two statements bind the inputs they need from the supplied values.
    Both are validated before the first execution. A locking plan returns
    ErrOperationDenied.

type CallMethod uint8
    CallMethod is the driver operation authorized for one execution.

const (
	// CallExec executes an affected-row mutation without a result shape.
	CallExec CallMethod = iota + 1
	// CallScan decodes a single read result.
	CallScan
	// CallEach visits results of a read.
	CallEach
	// CallReturning decodes a single row produced by a write.
	CallReturning
	// CallReturningEach streams rows produced by a write.
	CallReturningEach
)
type Capability uint32
    Capability is a bitmask of operations that RegistryConfig.Deny forbids on
    tables and bindings belonging to a Registry.

const (
	// DenyDelete rejects TableSpec.AllowDelete at Define/TryDefine time.
	DenyDelete Capability = 1 << iota
	// DenyUpsert rejects Table.DefineUpsert / TryDefineUpsert.
	DenyUpsert
	// DenyUnscopedWrites rejects derived writes, hand-written Rows.Exec and
	// binary COPY on unscoped sessions at runtime.
	DenyUnscopedWrites
	// DenyCopy rejects binary COPY operations checked via Rows.CheckCopy.
	DenyCopy
	// DenyLegacySQL requires registered descriptor calls and forbids SQL
	// fragments, raw session methods and raw transaction access.
	DenyLegacySQL
)
type Column[T any] struct {
	Name string
	Addr func(*T) any

	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Column is an escape-hatch column of a row type T (TableSpec.Columns): its
    name and the address of the value that holds it, for a column the db tags do
    not declare (a legacy conversion, a generated column, or an array wrapper).

func Col[T any](name string, addr func(*T) any) Column[T]
    Col declares an escape-hatch column. A field with a db tag cannot also be
    declared here: tag it db:"-" first.

func (c Column[T]) Once() Column[T]
    Once marks a column as written on insert only.

func (c Column[T]) Secret() Column[T]
    Secret marks a column's values as redacted in statement logs even when
    LogConfig.Values is ValuesAllowed.

type CountMode int
    CountMode controls how Rows.List obtains the total row count.

const (
	// CountExact runs SELECT count(*) with the active filter (default).
	CountExact CountMode = iota
	// CountNone skips the count query and returns -1 for total.
	CountNone
	// CountEstimate reads PostgreSQL's pg_class.reltuples estimate for the
	// table instead of scanning rows with COUNT(*).
	CountEstimate
)
type CursorValue struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    CursorValue is one typed field value at a keyset boundary.

func At[V any](field Field[V], value V) CursorValue
    At supplies one cursor component using the field's input codec.

func NullAt[V any](field Field[V]) CursorValue
    NullAt supplies a SQL NULL boundary for a nullable order field.

type DefinedColumn struct {
	Name     string
	GoType   string
	Nullable bool
	Role     string
	Once     bool
	Secret   bool
}
    DefinedColumn is one column's metadata for schema and privilege checks.

type DefinedPrivilege struct {
	Table, Privilege string
	Columns          []string
	Sequence         string
	Function         string
}
    DefinedPrivilege is one privilege a defined table or view needs:
      - SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE on table columns
      - DELETE on a table
      - USAGE on a serial key's sequence
      - EXECUTE on a PostgreSQL function signature (e.g. "public.fn(uuid,
        text)")

type Definition struct {
	Name       string
	Columns    []DefinedColumn
	Statements map[string]string
	// Privileges lists grants required by the descriptor itself. A plan
	// source declares an empty slice, with each plan's grants in StatementShapes.
	Privileges []DefinedPrivilege
	// StatementQueries records the owner of each composed-query variant and
	// registered scalar aggregate (for example, sum_rank belongs to sum:rank).
	StatementQueries map[string]string `json:",omitempty"`
	// StatementShapes holds verification metadata for each typed variant.
	StatementShapes map[string]StatementShape `json:",omitempty"`
}
    Definition is one defined table as Registry.Defined lists it.

type ErrorClass string
    ErrorClass is the fixed error classification string used in structured logs
    and error inspection.

const (
	ClassUnique                ErrorClass = "unique"
	ClassForeignKey            ErrorClass = "foreign_key"
	ClassCheck                 ErrorClass = "check"
	ClassNotNull               ErrorClass = "not_null"
	ClassSerialization         ErrorClass = "serialization"
	ClassDeadlock              ErrorClass = "deadlock"
	ClassCanceled              ErrorClass = "canceled"
	ClassRLSDenied             ErrorClass = "rls_denied"
	ClassInsufficientPrivilege ErrorClass = "insufficient_privilege"
	ClassOther                 ErrorClass = "other"
)
func ClassifyError(ctx context.Context, err error) (ErrorClass, error)
    ClassifyError inspects ctx and err (by context cancellation or PostgreSQL
    SQLSTATE) and returns its ErrorClass plus the matching tabula sentinel error
    (nil for ClassOther).

type ErrorPolicy struct {
	Classify func(ctx context.Context, err error) error
	// Sanitize supplies reviewed error text for structured logs. The default
	// logs the error class. Trace detail is configured separately with RawErrorDiagnostics.
	Sanitize    func(err error) string
	Conflict    error
	OnceChanged error
	NotDeleted  error
	RowCount    error
}
    ErrorPolicy maps execution and write-guard failures into the host's own
    error categories. Nil fields fall back to the package's default sentinels.

type Expr[V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Expr is a typed expression assembled from descriptor fields and inputs.

func AvgOf[V, R any](f Expr[V], result PGType[R]) Expr[R]
    AvgOf averages a numeric field. PostgreSQL returns numeric for integer and
    numeric inputs and float8 for floating-point inputs. The result is nullable.

func CountAll() Expr[int64]
    CountAll counts all rows, including those with NULL values.

func CountOf[V any](f Expr[V]) Expr[int64]
    CountOf counts non-null values of the input expression.

func MaxOf[V any](f Expr[V]) Expr[V]
    MaxOf computes the maximum of a field, with the same NULL contract as MinOf.

func MinOf[V any](f Expr[V]) Expr[V]
    MinOf computes the minimum of a field. An empty or all-NULL input yields
    NULL. PostgreSQL must provide the corresponding same-result-type min
    overload.

func SumOf[V, R any](f Expr[V], result PGType[R]) Expr[R]
    SumOf sums a numeric field. Supply the exact PostgreSQL result type and its
    Go representation. For example, sum(int4) returns int8 and sum(int8) returns
    numeric. An empty or all-NULL group yields NULL.

type Field[V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Field is a typed column on exactly one relation occurrence.

func FieldOf[R, V any](r Rel[R], name string, kind PGType[V]) Field[V]
    FieldOf resolves a descriptor column at definition time. The Go value type
    must match. A pointer field may be read as its nullable element type.

func (f Field[V]) Column() RowColumn
    Column retains the field's occurrence and type in a heterogeneous column
    list.

func (f Field[V]) Expr() Expr[V]
    Expr references this column on its declaring occurrence.

type Filter struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Filter accumulates optional predicates of one query over numbered bind
    parameters ($1..$n). Every value is bound; clause text is static adapter
    SQL.

    And replaces each single "?" of its clause, in order, with the next
    parameter. Write "??" to emit a literal "?" (for PostgreSQL JSONB operators
    such as ?, ?|, ?&). A marker/value mismatch is not repaired so malformed
    clauses fail loudly at prepare or execution.

func NewFilter(fixed ...any) *Filter
    NewFilter starts a filter whose fixed values occupy $1..$n.

func (f *Filter) And(clause string, values ...any)
    And appends one predicate; it is parenthesized when joined.

func (f *Filter) AndIf(cond bool, clause string, values ...any)
    AndIf appends clause with values only when cond is true.

func (f *Filter) Arg(v any) string
    Arg binds one value and returns its placeholder.

func (f *Filter) Args() []any
    Args returns a copy of the bound values in placeholder order.

func (f *Filter) In(column string, values ...any)
    In appends "<column> IN ($n, $n+1, ...)" for values. When values is empty,
    it appends "FALSE" so an empty list safely matches zero rows without
    producing invalid SQL. column must be a static SQL identifier.

func (f *Filter) Joined() string
    Joined returns the predicates joined by " AND " without leading connector.

func (f *Filter) Page(limit, offset any) string
    Page binds limit and offset and returns " LIMIT $a OFFSET $b".

func (f *Filter) Range(column string, from, to any)
    Range appends inclusive lower/upper bounds on column, omitting whichever
    bound is nil (including typed nil pointers). column must be a static SQL
    identifier.

func (f *Filter) Where() string
    Where returns the predicates as " AND (p1) AND (p2)", or "" when none.

type Formal[V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Formal is a typed argument position owned by one declared routine.

func FormalOf[R, V any](r *Routine[R], name string, kind PGType[V]) Formal[V]
    FormalOf resolves a named parameter on this exact signature.

	// Has unexported methods.

    GroupField is a physical field used in a SELECT grouping. Pass field.Expr()
    or field.Column(). Definitions check that every grouping belongs to the
    query.

type JSONValue struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    JSONValue holds a pointer to any Go value of a json/jsonb column.

func (v *JSONValue) Scan(src any) error

func (v *JSONValue) Value() (driver.Value, error)

type KeysetListing struct {
	// SortColumn optionally specifies a primary sort column (must be declared
	// on the Table). When empty, pagination orders directly by the key columns.
	SortColumn string
	// Direction is "ASC" (default when empty) or "DESC".
	Direction string
	// After holds the cursor values from the last item of the previous page,
	// matching the keyset tuple order: (SortColumn, key...) or (key...) when
	// SortColumn is empty or already part of the key.
	After []any
	// Limit is the maximum number of items to return (must be > 0). The engine
	// fetches Limit+1 rows to determine HasMore accurately.
	Limit int
	// Lock selects the row-lock clause and remembers locked rows for once checks.
	Lock LockMode
}

    key columns) without OFFSET scan degradation.

type KeysetPage[T any] struct {
	Items   []T
	HasMore bool
	Next    []any
}
    KeysetPage is one cursor-paginated slice plus whether another page exists.
    When HasMore is true, Next carries the cursor values extracted from the last
    returned item in tuple order for the subsequent After call.

type Listing struct {
	Order        string
	Size, Offset int
	Lock         LockMode
	Count        CountMode
}
    Listing is a List/Find page request: Order (table default when empty),
    Size/Offset (all rows when Size <= 0), Lock (a PostgreSQL row-lock mode),
    and Count (CountExact default, CountNone, or CountEstimate).

type LockMode uint8
    LockMode selects the PostgreSQL row-lock clause of a listing.

const (
	LockNone       LockMode = iota
	LockUpdate              // FOR UPDATE
	LockSkipLocked          // FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
	LockNoWait              // FOR UPDATE NOWAIT
	LockShare               // FOR SHARE
)
type LockWait uint8
    LockWait selects how an operation handles contention.

const (
	// Wait blocks until PostgreSQL grants the lock or the operation ends.
	Wait LockWait = iota + 1
	// SkipLocked excludes conflicting rows from a locking read.
	SkipLocked
	// NoWait raises PostgreSQL lock_not_available on a conflicting row.
	NoWait
	// Try returns false immediately on an advisory lock conflict.
	Try
)
type LogConfig struct {
	Logger        *slog.Logger
	Level         LogLevel
	LevelVar      *LogLevelVar
	SlowThreshold time.Duration
	Values        LogValues
	// Sample applies to LogAll only (0 < Sample < 1 samples that fraction;
	// 0 or >= 1 logs all statements). Errors and slow statements are never sampled.
	Sample float64
	// SQL includes the statement SQL as "tabula.sql" when Level is LogAll.
	SQL bool
	// Now supplies the clock for statement duration, defaulting to time.Now.
	// Active logging or a Metrics hook enables timing.
	Now func() time.Time
}

    Logging requires a registry or binding logger and a level other than LogOff.

type LogLevel int32
    LogLevel controls which statement executions are emitted to the configured
    slog.Logger.

const (
	// LogOff disables statement logging completely (default).
	LogOff LogLevel = iota
	// LogErrors logs failed statements only.
	LogErrors
	// LogSlow logs failed statements and statements slower than SlowThreshold.
	LogSlow
	// LogAll logs every statement (for debugging; not for production traffic).
	LogAll
)
type LogLevelVar struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}

    across one or more registries or adjusted without restarting.

func NewLogLevelVar(level LogLevel) *LogLevelVar

func (l *LogLevelVar) Level() LogLevel

func (l *LogLevelVar) Set(level LogLevel)

type LogValues int
    LogValues controls whether bound argument values appear in statement logs.

const (
	// ValuesNever omits all bound argument values from log output (default).
	ValuesNever LogValues = iota
	// ValuesRedacted logs only each argument's Go type and length.

	// ValuesAllowed logs bound argument values except secret columns and

)
type Metrics interface {
	Observe(ctx context.Context, info TraceInfo, duration time.Duration, rows int64, errClass ErrorClass)
}
    Metrics observes latency, row count, and error class for each
    statement execution. Passed explicitly via RegistryConfig.Metrics or
    RunnerOptions.Metrics; nil disables metrics.

    It panics on declaration errors.

type ObserveMask uint8
    ObserveMask identifies which observability signals a runner session handles
    itself so that a Registry skips duplicate emissions for those signals.

const (
	ObserveTrace ObserveMask = 1 << iota
	ObserveMetrics
	ObserveLog
	// ObserveTag indicates the session tags statements with SQL comments and
	// needs StatementMeta propagated on the context even without other hooks.

type Observer struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}

    optional SQL comment tagging for both descriptor statements and hand-written
    inline SQL.

    no observability signal or statement tagging is configured.

func (o *Observer) Signals() ObserveMask

func (o *Observer) Start(ctx context.Context, scopeLabel, query string, args []any) (context.Context, func(rows int64, err error))

    updated context plus a finish callback that records row count and error.

func (o *Observer) TagSQL(ctx context.Context, query string) string
    TagSQL returns query prefixed with `/* tabula:<key> */ ` when TagStatements
    is enabled. Key comes from descriptor metadata when present or from the
    normalized inline SQL fingerprint otherwise.

type ObserverConfig struct {
	// RawErrorDiagnostics passes original errors to the statement tracer. Driver
	// messages can contain bound values. The default traces the class and SQLSTATE.
	RawErrorDiagnostics bool
	Role                string
	Tracer              Tracer
	Metrics             Metrics
	Log                 LogConfig
	// Sanitize supplies reviewed log text for errors. The default is the error class.

}

type OrderSpec struct {
	Columns          map[string]string
	DefaultColumn    string
	DefaultDirection string
	TieBreaker       string

    OrderSpec resolves caller-supplied sort field and direction against a fixed
    whitelist and returns a safe SQL ORDER BY expression for Listing.Order.

func MustOrderSpec(spec OrderSpec) OrderSpec
    MustOrderSpec validates spec and returns an immutable copy. Any malformed
    specification panics at package initialization.

func (s OrderSpec) Resolve(by, dir string) string
    Resolve maps caller-provided sort key and direction to a safe SQL ORDER BY
    expression (without leading "ORDER BY").

type OutputField[V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    OutputField is a named projection target on a registered View.

func Output[T, S, V any](view *View[T, S], name string, kind PGType[V]) OutputField[V]
    Output resolves a view column and checks its Go type at definition time.

type PGType[V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    PGType pairs a Go value type with an exact PostgreSQL catalog type. Its zero
    value cannot be used to declare a column or parameter.

func ArrayOf[V any](element PGType[V]) PGType[[]V]
    ArrayOf declares a PostgreSQL array of the given element type. Inputs use
    RegistryConfig.ArrayArg, or the driver's native slice binding when it is
    nil. The array codec is responsible for encoding its elements.

func Bool() PGType[bool]
    Bool declares PostgreSQL boolean.

func CatalogType[V any](schema, name string, encode func(V) any) PGType[V]
    CatalogType declares a schema-qualified PostgreSQL type. Supply its encoding
    for a bound input, or nil when the driver already accepts V. Both names are
    exact catalog identifiers. No portion is interpreted as a SQL expression.

func Int4() PGType[int32]
    Int4 declares PostgreSQL integer.

func Int8() PGType[int64]
    Int8 declares PostgreSQL bigint.

func Text() PGType[string]
    Text declares PostgreSQL text.

func Timestamptz() PGType[time.Time]
    Timestamptz declares PostgreSQL timestamp with time zone.

func Varchar(n int) PGType[string]
    Varchar declares PostgreSQL character varying with a column length in
    characters. Verification checks the column modifier. The parameter uses
    unbounded varchar so comparisons preserve the entire value and PostgreSQL
    applies its native length rules on assignment.

type Pred = Expr[bool]
    Pred is a PostgreSQL boolean expression. A nullable predicate follows SQL
    three-valued logic when it is used in WHERE.

func And(first, second Pred, rest ...Pred) Pred
    And combines two or more typed predicates in declaration order.

func Any[V any](value Expr[V], array Expr[[]V]) Pred
    Any tests equality with any element of a PostgreSQL array declared with
    ArrayOf. An empty array yields false and a NULL array yields NULL.

func Eq[V any](left, right Expr[V]) Pred
    Eq compares two expressions of the same PostgreSQL type.

func Ge[V any](a, b Expr[V]) Pred
    Ge compares two expressions using PostgreSQL greater-than-or-equal
    semantics.

func Gt[V any](a, b Expr[V]) Pred
    Gt compares two expressions using PostgreSQL greater-than semantics.

func ILike[V, P ~string](value Expr[V], pattern Expr[P]) Pred
    ILike matches a string pattern case-insensitively using PostgreSQL's locale.

func In[V any](value, first Expr[V], rest ...Expr[V]) Pred
    In tests membership in a nonempty, fixed list of typed expressions. Use Any
    with an array input when the list length varies between calls.

func IsDistinct[V any](left, right Expr[V]) Pred
    IsDistinct compares values using PostgreSQL's null-safe inequality.

func IsNotDistinct[V any](left, right Expr[V]) Pred
    IsNotDistinct compares values using PostgreSQL's null-safe equality.

func IsNull[V any](v Expr[V]) Pred
    IsNull tests SQL NULL and always returns a non-null boolean.

func Le[V any](a, b Expr[V]) Pred
    Le compares two expressions using PostgreSQL less-than-or-equal semantics.

func Like[V, P ~string](value Expr[V], pattern Expr[P]) Pred
    Like matches a PostgreSQL string pattern. The pattern retains the database's
    wildcard and escape semantics. Bind a pattern input with BindValue.

func Lt[V any](a, b Expr[V]) Pred
    Lt compares two expressions using PostgreSQL less-than semantics.

func Ne[V any](a, b Expr[V]) Pred
    Ne compares two expressions for inequality.

func Not(p Pred) Pred
    Not negates a PostgreSQL boolean, preserving SQL NULL.

func Or(first, second Pred, rest ...Pred) Pred
    Or combines predicates in declaration order with SQL three-valued logic.

type Projection struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Projection assigns a typed expression to one output column.

func Project[V any](target OutputField[V], value Expr[V]) Projection
    Project pairs an output target with an expression of the same Go value type.
    Compilation also checks the PostgreSQL types, nullability and output order.

type Query[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Query is a validated, compiled composed query owned by a View.

func (q *Query[T, S]) Bind(s Session[S]) *QueryRows[T, S]
    Bind binds q to session s, applying the owning Registry's A4 SessionKey
    check.

type QueryFilter struct {
	Name   string
	SQL    string
	Secret bool
}
    QueryFilter declares one named, optional WHERE fragment of a composed query.
    Fragment parameters are numbered locally starting at $1 (independent of
    Select/Where base parameters) and may be reused across multiple predicates
    (for example "(o.code ILIKE $1 OR c.name ILIKE $1)").

type QueryKeyset struct {
	Sort      string
	Direction SortDirection
	Limit     int
	After     []any
}
    QueryKeyset requests a cursor-paginated result from QueryRows.ListKeyset.
    A fixed sort direction governs both the row order and the After comparison.
    Direction selects the order for sorts declared with SortDefault.

type QueryOrder struct {
	Sort      string
	Direction SortDirection
}
    QueryOrder selects sorting for unpaged QueryRows.Find and QueryRows.Iter.
    Direction applies to sort terms declared with SortDefault. Fixed terms keep
    their direction.

type QueryOrderSpec struct {
	Default          string
	DefaultDirection SortDirection
	Sorts            []QuerySort
	TieBreaker       []QuerySortTerm
}
    QueryOrderSpec declares the whitelisted sort choices and optional
    tie-breaker terms of a composed query.

type QueryPage struct {
	Sort      string
	Direction SortDirection
	Size      int
	Offset    int
	Count     CountMode
}
    QueryPage requests an offset-paginated result from QueryRows.List.
    Offset must be nonnegative and within any positive QuerySpec.MaxOffset.
    Direction applies to sort terms declared with SortDefault. Fixed terms keep
    their direction.

type QueryParams struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    QueryParams holds base arguments and named filter arguments for a composed
    Query. The zero value is directly usable (like strings.Builder and Filter)
    for queries without base arguments:

        var p tabula.QueryParams
        if since != nil {
            p.With("since", *since)
        }
        rows, total, err := q.Bind(sess).List(ctx, &p, page)

    NewQueryParams and With/WithIf defensively copy their argument slices.
    Errors such as unknown or duplicate filter names and arity mismatches
    are reported by the bound query operation before any I/O. Once built,
    a *QueryParams is read-only during execution and safe to reuse across
    operations (such as Count followed by List), though it is not safe for
    concurrent mutation.

func NewQueryParams(baseArgs ...any) *QueryParams
    NewQueryParams creates a *QueryParams seeded with baseArgs ($1..$k).

func (p *QueryParams) With(name string, args ...any) *QueryParams
    With enables the named filter with args (0, 1 or more values matching the
    filter's fragment-local $1..$m placeholders) and returns p for chaining.
    Calling With on a nil *QueryParams panics so conditional code never silently
    drops a filter. A supplied nil (including a typed nil) binds SQL NULL.

func (p *QueryParams) WithIf(cond bool, name string, args ...any) *QueryParams
    WithIf calls With(name, args...) when cond is true and returns p unchanged
    otherwise. Calling WithIf on a nil *QueryParams panics.

    Caution: Go evaluates function arguments before entering WithIf. Never write
    `p.WithIf(since != nil, "since", *since)` — dereferencing `*since` panics
    when `since` is nil. Guard pointer dereferences with an ordinary `if` block:

        if since != nil {
            p.With("since", *since)
        }

type QueryRows[T, S any] struct {
	readBinding[T, S]
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    QueryRows is a compiled Query bound to one Session.

func (r *QueryRows[T, S]) Count(ctx context.Context, params *QueryParams) (int64, error)
    Count returns the exact number of matching rows before pagination.

func (r *QueryRows[T, S]) Find(ctx context.Context, params *QueryParams, order QueryOrder) ([]T, error)
    Find reads all matching rows in the selected order without running COUNT(*).

func (r *QueryRows[T, S]) Iter(ctx context.Context, params *QueryParams, order QueryOrder) iter.Seq2[T, error]
    Iter streams all matching rows in the selected order. Breaking the range
    closes the cursor.

func (r *QueryRows[T, S]) List(ctx context.Context, params *QueryParams, page QueryPage) ([]T, int64, error)
    List reads one offset-paginated page plus optional exact total count.
    CountMode must be CountExact (default) or CountNone (total = -1).

func (r *QueryRows[T, S]) ListKeyset(ctx context.Context, params *QueryParams, page QueryKeyset) (KeysetPage[T], error)
    ListKeyset reads one cursor-paginated page without OFFSET, fetching Limit+1
    rows to set HasMore and populating Next from the last returned item.

func (r *QueryRows[T, S]) WithLogger(logger *slog.Logger) *QueryRows[T, S]
    WithLogger returns a handle with a per-binding logger override, retaining
    any A4 rejection error.

type QueryScope struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    QueryScope declares how a composed query applies row scope on a scoped
    Registry. On a scoped Registry (S != struct{}), leaving Scope unset fails
    closed at DefineQuery time; choose ScopeColumns, ScopeByRLS or ScopeGlobal.

func ScopeByRLS() QueryScope
    ScopeByRLS declares that row scope is enforced by PostgreSQL RLS policies
    (or CTE/base predicates) rather than an outer scope column predicate.

func ScopeColumns(cols ...string) QueryScope
    ScopeColumns injects outer WHERE predicates (<col> = $n) using the bound
    session's scope value on scoped sessions, omitting them on validated
    unscoped sessions. All listed columns share one parameter slot. Applies to
    driving and inner-joined tables; outer-joined tables must correlate in ON,
    use a composite foreign key or rely on PostgreSQL RLS.

func ScopeGlobal() QueryScope
    ScopeGlobal declares a view over global lookup tables that have no row
    scope.

type QuerySort struct {
	Key       string
	Expr      string
	Column    string
	Direction SortDirection
}
    QuerySort declares one whitelisted caller sort key on QueryOrderSpec.
    Expr is a static SQL expression and cannot contain parameter placeholders.

type QuerySortTerm struct {
	Expr      string
	Column    string
	Direction SortDirection
}
    QuerySortTerm pairs a parameter-free SQL ordering expression with its
    matching View column.

type QuerySpec struct {
	Select    string
	Where     string
	Tail      string
	CountBase string
	Scope     QueryScope
	Filters   []QueryFilter
	Order     QueryOrderSpec
	MaxLimit  int
	// MaxOffset is the largest permitted QueryPage.Offset, inclusive. Zero allows any nonnegative offset.
	MaxOffset int
	Keyset    bool
}
    QuerySpec declares a view-owned composed query using explicit Select, Where,
    optional Tail (GROUP BY / HAVING) and optional optimized CountBase segments.

    Base parameters ($1..$k) share one namespace across Select, Where, Tail and
    CountBase. Filter fragments use fragment-local $1..$m numbering rebased at
    compile time.

type ReadPlan[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    ReadPlan owns the compiled scoped forms of an explicit SELECT.

func DefineRead[T, S any](out *View[T, S], name string, query ReadSelect, observe ...StatementOption) *ReadPlan[T, S]
    DefineRead registers an explicit typed SELECT. It panics on a declaration
    error.

func TryDefineRead[T, S any](out *View[T, S], name string, query ReadSelect, observe ...StatementOption) (*ReadPlan[T, S], error)
    TryDefineRead registers every permitted scope variant together. No shape is
    published when a declaration fails.

func (p *ReadPlan[T, S]) Bind(s Session[S]) *BoundReadPlan[T, S]
    Bind attaches the plan to a session from its registry.

type ReadSelect struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    ReadSelect is an immutable declaration of one explicit SELECT. Each method
    returns a new value. DefineRead freezes its SQL and verification metadata.

func Select(fields ...Projection) ReadSelect
    Select projects expressions into the declared output view in field order.

func (q ReadSelect) AllowUnscoped() ReadSelect
    AllowUnscoped also registers the form that omits column-scope predicates.
    It requires an unscoped session. PostgreSQL RLS applies in both forms.

func (q ReadSelect) CrossJoin(right ReadSource) ReadSelect
    CrossJoin returns the product of the visible rows of both sides.

func (q ReadSelect) From(source ReadSource) ReadSelect
    From names the first physical occurrence.

func (q ReadSelect) GroupBy(fields ...GroupField) ReadSelect
    GroupBy groups rows by the declared fields of their respective occurrences.

func (q ReadSelect) Having(terms ...Pred) ReadSelect
    Having filters aggregate groups after grouping.

func (q ReadSelect) InnerJoin(right ReadSource, on Pred) ReadSelect
    InnerJoin adds matching rows from an explicitly named right occurrence.
    The predicate can reference the right occurrence and preceding sources.

func (q ReadSelect) LeftJoin(right ReadSource, on Pred) ReadSelect
    LeftJoin preserves left rows when the right occurrence has no visible match.
    Its scope and live-row conditions are part of ON.

func (q ReadSelect) Lock(lock RowLock) ReadSelect
    Lock applies a row lock to one eligible occurrence of an ungrouped read.

func (q ReadSelect) OrderBy(terms ...RowTerm) ReadSelect
    OrderBy declares the ordered physical fields of this result.

func (q ReadSelect) Where(terms ...Pred) ReadSelect
    Where restricts rows before grouping. Multiple terms are combined with AND.

type ReadSource interface {
	// Has unexported methods.
}
    ReadSource identifies a physical occurrence in an explicit SELECT. FromTable
    and RowsFrom provide sources. Use RowsFrom to specify a scope or soft-delete
    column with a custom PostgreSQL type.

type Registry[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Registry owns registered value converters, error policy, logging, tracing,
    metrics, and the list of defined tables and views. Applications normally
    declare one package-level Registry and may construct isolated registries in
    tests.

func NewRegistry[S any](cfg RegistryConfig[S]) *Registry[S]
    NewRegistry creates a Registry preloaded with built-in scalar zero
    converters (string, bool, int, int32, int64, float64, time.Time).

func (r *Registry[S]) Defined() []Definition
    Defined lists every table defined in r in definition order. The returned
    definitions are deep copies.

func (r *Registry[S]) DefinedViews() []ViewDefinition
    DefinedViews returns snapshots of all registered views in definition order.

func (r *Registry[S]) LogLevel() LogLevel
    LogLevel returns this Registry's active statement logging level.

func (r *Registry[S]) Resolve(ft reflect.Type, jsonOption, zeroOption bool) (func(any) any, error)
    Resolve returns the converter of a pointer to a value of type ft in r:
     1. json option: json text in and out;
     2. zero option: registered scalar, NULL read as the zero value;
     3. registry types (registered via RegisterType / ScopeWrap);
     4. types whose pointer implements sql.Scanner and driver.Valuer;
     5. database/sql native primitives (bool, ints, floats, string, []byte,
        time.Time).

func (r *Registry[S]) SQLAuthority() SQLAuthority
    SQLAuthority returns this registry's verification credential. Pass it to a
    driver that executes authorized statements for this registry.

func (r *Registry[S]) Seal(key SessionKey) error
    Seal atomically attaches key to a Registry created with RequireSealed:
    true and a zero SessionKey. It fails on an open registry, a zero key, or any
    registry that already has a key (including a repeat call with the same key).

func (r *Registry[S]) SetLogLevel(level LogLevel)
    SetLogLevel atomically updates this Registry's statement logging level.

type RegistryConfig[S any] struct {
	// Prefix labels panic and declaration error messages (defaults to "tabula").
	Prefix string
	// ScopeID extracts the raw SQL bind argument from a scope value S.
	// When omitted, the scope value itself identifies the row scope.
	ScopeID func(S) any
	// ScopeWrap wraps a *S pointer into a sql.Scanner / driver.Valuer.
	// Optional when S already implements sql.Scanner and driver.Valuer.
	ScopeWrap func(*S) any
	// ScopeLog formats a scope value S into the "tabula.scope" log attribute.
	// When nil, "tabula.scope" is omitted from log entries.
	ScopeLog func(S) string
	// ArrayArg wraps a Go slice for PostgreSQL "= ANY($n)" parameters
	// (e.g. pqdriver.Array). When nil, slices are passed as-is (native pgx).
	ArrayArg func(any) any
	// ArrayColumn resolves a db:"...,array" column's Go slice type into a
	// converter (e.g. pqdriver.ArrayColumn).
	ArrayColumn func(reflect.Type) (func(any) any, error)
	// Errors maps driver and write-guard failures for Rows created from this
	// registry.
	Errors ErrorPolicy
	// Log configures opt-in structured statement logging via log/slog.
	Log LogConfig
	// Tracer optionally wraps every statement execution in a tracing span.
	Tracer Tracer
	// RawErrorDiagnostics passes original errors to the statement tracer. Driver
	// messages can contain bound values. The default traces the class and SQLSTATE.
	RawErrorDiagnostics bool
	// Metrics optionally records latency, row count, and error class per statement.
	Metrics Metrics
	// SessionKey binds the registry at construction so Bind accepts only sessions
	// carrying a matching SessionProof signed for that exact session instance.
	SessionKey SessionKey
	// RequireSealed creates a fail-closed registry that rejects every Bind until
	// startup code seals it once with Registry.Seal(key). Ignored when SessionKey
	// is already non-zero.
	RequireSealed bool
	// Deny forbids selected table capabilities (such as DenyDelete, DenyUpsert,
	// DenyUnscopedWrites, DenyCopy) across all descriptors in this registry.
	Deny Capability
}
    RegistryConfig configures one isolated Registry for scope type S.

type Rel[T any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Rel identifies one occurrence of a physical table in a query. Two
    occurrences are distinct even when they use the same descriptor and alias.

func FromTable[T, K, S any](t *Table[T, K, S], alias string, scope RelationScope) Rel[T]
    FromTable declares an occurrence of a registered, schema-qualified Table.
    The requested strategy must match the descriptor's declared enforcement.

type RelationScope struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RelationScope identifies the enforcement declared for a physical relation.

func ByRLS() RelationScope
    ByRLS delegates scoping to PostgreSQL row-level security. A compiled shape
    records the physical relation for role-bound ENABLE and FORCE checks.

func ByScopeColumn() RelationScope
    ByScopeColumn binds the session scope to the descriptor's tagged scope
    column.

func Global() RelationScope
    Global declares a physical relation whose rows do not depend on session
    scope.

type RetryConfig struct {
	// MaxAttempts is the total number of attempts including the initial run
	// (defaults to 3 when <= 0).
	MaxAttempts int
	// BaseDelay is the initial exponential backoff delay (defaults to 25ms when <= 0).
	BaseDelay time.Duration
	// MaxDelay caps the backoff delay (defaults to 500ms when <= 0).
	MaxDelay time.Duration
	// ShouldRetry overrides retry eligibility (defaults to IsRetryable).
	ShouldRetry func(error) bool
	// Sleep overrides the delay wait (useful for deterministic unit tests).
	Sleep func(context.Context, time.Duration) error
}
    RetryConfig controls explicit retries for transient PostgreSQL transaction
    conflicts (serialization failure 40001 and deadlock 40P01).

type Routine[V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Routine is an immutable, schema-qualified function signature.

func DeclareRoutine[V any](spec RoutineSpec[V], params ...RoutineParameter) *Routine[V]
    DeclareRoutine freezes a function signature at startup. Supply the
    parameters in catalog order. Use AdvisoryXactLock for built-in advisory
    operations.

type RoutineArgument struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RoutineArgument assigns a typed expression to a signature's formal.

func Arg[V any](formal Formal[V], value Expr[V]) RoutineArgument
    Arg pairs a formal with an expression of the same Go type. Registration
    checks its PostgreSQL type and emits an explicit cast at the call site.

type RoutineCardinality uint8
    RoutineCardinality is the number of results a function can return.

const (
	// RoutineOne declares an ordinary function returning one value, possibly NULL.
	RoutineOne RoutineCardinality = iota + 1
	// RoutineSet declares a function returning SETOF its result type.
	RoutineSet
)
type RoutineParameter struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RoutineParameter declares one input in PostgreSQL signature order.

func Parameter[V any](name string, kind PGType[V]) RoutineParameter
    Parameter names a formal parameter and its exact PostgreSQL type.

type RoutinePlan[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RoutinePlan executes one registered function call using its declared result
    cardinality and a one-column View's decoder.

func DefineRoutine[T, S, V any](view *View[T, S], key string, r *Routine[V], args ...RoutineArgument) *RoutinePlan[T, S]
    DefineRoutine registers a standalone call to a declared function. Each input
    needs exactly one Arg. Values bind in signature order. The output view must
    have one column compatible with the declared result.

func TryDefineRoutine[T, S, V any](view *View[T, S], key string, r *Routine[V], args ...RoutineArgument) (*RoutinePlan[T, S], error)
    TryDefineRoutine registers the complete call or returns a declaration error.

func (p *RoutinePlan[T, S]) Bind(s Session[S]) *BoundRoutinePlan[T, S]
    Bind attaches the function plan to a session from its registry.

type RoutineRequirement struct {
	Signature, ResultType                 string
	ReturnsSet, ReadOnly, SecurityDefiner bool
}
    RoutineRequirement describes one exact, non-variadic pg_proc entry.
    Signature and ResultType use schema-qualified catalog names. ReadOnly
    requires STABLE or IMMUTABLE. SecurityDefiner must match the function.

type RoutineSpec[V any] struct {
	Schema, Name                        string
	Result                              PGType[V]
	Cardinality                         RoutineCardinality
	Nullable, ReadOnly, SecurityDefiner bool
}
    RoutineSpec declares a scalar or set-returning PostgreSQL function. ReadOnly
    is an explicit assertion about the reviewed body. The default requires write
    authorization. Nullable describes individual result values.

type RowAssignment struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RowAssignment assigns a typed expression to a field on the target
    occurrence.

func Assign[V any](field Field[V], value Expr[V]) RowAssignment
    Assign sets a column to a compatible expression, evaluated on the old row.

type RowChoice struct {
	Filters       []string
	Order         string
	Page          RowPage
	Limit, Offset int64
	After         RowCursor
}
    RowChoice selects precompiled alternatives. Filters lists the enabled
    optional predicates. Order names a declared ordering.

type RowColumn struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RowColumn identifies a typed descriptor field in a GROUP BY or source
    declaration.

type RowCursor struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RowCursor is a boundary issued for one plan and order. Its zero value
    denotes the absence of a cursor.

type RowFilter struct {
	Where         Pred
	Optional      []RowPredicate
	AllowUnscoped bool
	Budget        int
	Observe       []StatementOption
}
    RowFilter declares the common WHERE terms and the registration budget. Where
    is required for mutations. Column-scoped plans register scoped statements by
    default. AllowUnscoped adds a separate unscoped family.

type RowLock struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RowLock identifies a locking strength, a specific occurrence and a wait
    mode.

func ForRows[T any](strength RowLockStrength, target Rel[T], wait LockWait) RowLock
    ForRows declares a lock on target. Wait, SkipLocked and NoWait are valid.

type RowLockStrength uint8
    RowLockStrength selects the PostgreSQL locking clause on a physical
    relation.

const (
	ForUpdate RowLockStrength = iota + 1
	ForNoKeyUpdate
	ForShare
	ForKeyShare
)
type RowOrder struct {
	Name  string
	Terms []RowTerm
}
    RowOrder names one complete ordering, including its tie-breakers.

type RowPage uint8
    RowPage selects a registered page form.

const (
	// Unpaged returns the entire filtered result.
	Unpaged RowPage = iota
	// OffsetPage binds Limit and Offset.
	OffsetPage
	// FirstPage binds Limit and starts at the beginning of a keyset order.
	FirstPage
	// AfterPage binds Limit and the cursor of the same plan and order.
	AfterPage
)
type RowPages struct {
	Unpaged, Offset, Keyset bool
	MaxLimit, MaxOffset     int64
}
    RowPages declares the allowed page forms and their inclusive bounds. Its
    zero value registers only an unpaged read. Keyset registers first and after.

type RowPredicate struct {
	Name string
	When Pred
}
    RowPredicate enables one named, independently optional WHERE term.

type RowSet struct {
	Name        string
	Assignments []RowAssignment
}
    RowSet names a complete, ordered set of simultaneous assignments.

type RowSource[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RowSource ties a single occurrence to its descriptor's keys and live-row
    policy.

func RowsFrom[T, K, S any](table *Table[T, K, S], rel Rel[T], columns ...RowColumn) RowSource[T, S]
    RowsFrom uses the same occurrence as FieldOf. Supply the catalog type of
    a scope or deleted field with field.Column() when its Go type needs an
    explicit mapping. ByRLS and Global need no scope field.

type RowTerm struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RowTerm orders one physical field. PostgreSQL orders NULLs last for
    ascending terms and first for descending terms.

func Asc[V any](f Field[V]) RowTerm
    Asc orders a field from least to greatest.

func Desc[V any](f Field[V]) RowTerm
    Desc orders a field from greatest to least.

type RowVersion struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RowVersion compares the existing version with a required input.

func ExpectVersion[V any](field Field[V], expected Slot[V]) RowVersion
    ExpectVersion declares a version check for every shape of a mutation.
    UpdateMany also increments each matching row's version.

type Rows[T, K, S any] struct {
	readBinding[T, S]

	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Rows is a Table bound to one Session. Bind it once per transaction: it
    remembers the once columns of rows it locked, and Save / UpdateWhere refuse
    a locked row whose once columns changed.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Args(row T) []any
    Args returns bound values matching Table.Insert().

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) CheckCopy() error
    CheckCopy validates session provenance, write mode, DenyCopy and
    DenyUnscopedWrites before bulk COPY protocols (such as pgxdriver.CopyFrom)
    take any empty-input shortcut or touch the driver.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) CheckWrite(row *T) error
    CheckWrite validates session provenance, permission to insert,
    unscoped-write policy and row scope for the supplied row. Driver adapters
    use it when sending rows through a bulk protocol such as COPY.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Delete(ctx context.Context, key K) error
    Delete physically deletes the row identified by key within the session
    scope. Requires TableSpec.AllowDelete = true. Returns the conflict error
    when zero rows matched (missing or already deleted).

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) DeleteWhere(ctx context.Context, where string, values ...any) (int64, error)
    DeleteWhere physically deletes rows matching the session scope and a
    required non-empty static predicate over "?" placeholders. Requires
    TableSpec.AllowDelete = true. Returns the affected row count; zero rows
    matched is not an error.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Exec(ctx context.Context, want int64, query string, args ...any) error
    Exec runs a hand-written write and confirms its row count (when want >= 0).

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Exists(ctx context.Context, where func(*Filter)) (bool, error)
    Exists reports whether any undeleted row in the session's row scope matches
    where (a Filter builder callback; nil checks whether any live row exists).

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) ExistsBy(ctx context.Context, where string, values ...any) (bool, error)
    ExistsBy reports whether any undeleted row in the session's row scope
    matches where (a static predicate over bound "?" markers).

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Find(ctx context.Context, where func(*Filter), l Listing) ([]T, error)
    Find reads undeleted rows matching where without running COUNT(*).

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Get(ctx context.Context, key K) (*T, error)
    Get reads the undeleted row key without a lock; nil when missing.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) GetBy(ctx context.Context, where string, values ...any) (*T, error)
    GetBy reads the first undeleted row (in Order) matching where; nil when
    missing. where is a static predicate over bound "?" markers.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) GetMany(ctx context.Context, keys []K) ([]T, error)
    GetMany reads all undeleted rows whose key is in keys within the session
    scope. An empty keys slice returns nil, nil without issuing SQL.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Insert(ctx context.Context, row *T) error
    Insert writes row. With a serial key, the default mode reads the generated
    key back into row. WriteInsertOnly leaves the key field untouched.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) InsertMany(ctx context.Context, rows []T) error
    InsertMany inserts all rows using multi-row INSERT ... VALUES (...), (...).
    An empty slice returns nil without issuing SQL. Large batches are chunked
    automatically to stay within PostgreSQL's 65,535 bind parameter limit.
    All rows in a scoped call must share the session's scope.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) InsertReturning(ctx context.Context, row *T, columns ...string) error
    InsertReturning writes row and scans the named columns (or all table columns
    when columns is empty) back into row via RETURNING.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Iter(ctx context.Context, where func(*Filter), l Listing) iter.Seq2[T, error]
    Iter streams a Find query, applying the same scope, ordering, paging
    and lock mode. Breaking the range closes the cursor. Locked rows retain
    once-column snapshots.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) List(ctx context.Context, where func(*Filter), l Listing) ([]T, int64, error)
    List reads undeleted rows matching where for the listing plus total
    count according to l.Count (CountExact default, CountNone returns -1,
    CountEstimate reads PostgreSQL pg_class.reltuples).

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) ListKeyset(ctx context.Context, where func(*Filter), l KeysetListing) (KeysetPage[T], error)
    ListKeyset reads one cursor-paginated page of undeleted rows matching where
    in deterministic (SortColumn, key...) order without OFFSET. Invalid listing
    options return an error before the filter callback or database is used.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Lock(ctx context.Context, key K) (*T, error)
    Lock reads the undeleted row key FOR UPDATE; nil when missing.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) LockBy(ctx context.Context, where string, values ...any) (*T, error)
    LockBy reads and locks (FOR UPDATE) the first undeleted row (in Order)
    matching where; nil when missing. The row's once columns are remembered.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) LockMany(ctx context.Context, keys []K) ([]T, error)
    LockMany reads and locks (FOR UPDATE) all undeleted rows whose key is
    in keys in deterministic ascending key order to avoid deadlocks across
    concurrent transactions. Once columns of every locked row are remembered.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Save(ctx context.Context, row T) error
    Save writes every updatable column of the undeleted row at the previous
    version (when versioned); no row updated returns the conflict error.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) SaveReturning(ctx context.Context, row *T, columns ...string) error
    SaveReturning writes every updatable column of the undeleted row (honoring
    optimistic version CAS and once-column protection) and scans the named
    columns (or all columns when empty) back into row via RETURNING. No row
    matched returns the conflict error.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Scan(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Scan runs a hand-written single-row SELECT.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Scope() *Filter
    Scope starts a Filter seeded with the session scope predicate (none on an
    unscoped session) and soft-delete predicate. A rejected binding yields a
    FALSE predicate without consulting the session.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Select(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) ([]T, error)
    Select scans every row of a hand-written SELECT over Table.Cols().

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) SelectIter(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) iter.Seq2[T, error]
    SelectIter streams a hand-written SELECT over Table.Cols().

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Set(ctx context.Context, row T, columns ...string) error
    Set writes only the named columns of the undeleted row (no version check).

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) SetExpr(ctx context.Context, key K, assignments ...Assignment) error
    SetExpr applies assignments to one live row by key within the session scope.
    Like Set, it checks the affected row count and does not perform version CAS.
    Key, scope, deleted, version and once columns cannot be expression targets.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) SetWhere(ctx context.Context, row T, columns []string, where string, values ...any) (bool, error)
    SetWhere writes only the named columns of the undeleted row matching key
    (and scope when declared) plus an extra static SQL predicate over "?"
    placeholders. Reports whether a row matched; zero rows is not an error.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) SoftDelete(ctx context.Context, row T) error
    SoftDelete is a Save of a row whose deleted column is marked deleted
    (non-nil *time.Time, true bool, or configured DeletedValue).

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) UpdateWhere(ctx context.Context, row T, where string, values ...any) (bool, error)
    UpdateWhere writes every updatable column of the undeleted row matching key
    (and scope/version when declared) plus an extra static SQL predicate over
    "?" placeholders. Reports whether a row matched; zero rows is not an error.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) Upsert(ctx context.Context, plan *UpsertPlan[T, K, S], row *T) (bool, error)
    Upsert executes a pre-declared UpsertPlan for row. Returns (true, nil) when
    a row was inserted or updated, and (false, nil) when DO NOTHING or a DO
    UPDATE WHERE guard skipped the write. Any Returning columns are scanned into
    row.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) UpsertMany(ctx context.Context, plan *UpsertPlan[T, K, S], rows []T) (int64, error)
    UpsertMany returns the number of inserted or updated rows, excluding
    conflicts skipped by DO NOTHING or WHERE. The batch only returns a count:
    it omits the plan's RETURNING list and leaves the input slice untouched.
    On error the count covers successful chunks in the current transaction.

func (r *Rows[T, K, S]) WithLogger(logger *slog.Logger) *Rows[T, K, S]
    WithLogger returns a Rows handle sharing the same Table and Session with a
    per-binding logger override.

type RowsPlan[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RowsPlan owns the registered read shapes for one output view.

func DefineRows[T, R, S any](out *View[T, S], name string, src RowSource[R, S], spec RowsSpec, project ...Projection) *RowsPlan[T, S]
    DefineRows registers a named single-table read. It panics on declaration
    errors.

func TryDefineRows[T, R, S any](out *View[T, S], name string, src RowSource[R, S], spec RowsSpec, project ...Projection) (*RowsPlan[T, S], error)
    TryDefineRows registers the complete read plan or returns an error without
    publishing any shape. The projection covers the view in descriptor order.

func (p *RowsPlan[T, S]) Bind(s Session[S]) *BoundRowsPlan[T, S]
    Bind attaches this read plan to a session from the same registry.

func (p *RowsPlan[T, S]) Cursor(order string, values ...CursorValue) (RowCursor, error)
    Cursor validates a boundary against the specific plan, order, field types
    and arity. Supply values in order, taken from the last row of the prior
    page.

type RowsSpec struct {
	RowFilter
	GroupBy []RowColumn
	Orders  []RowOrder
	Pages   RowPages
	// Lock applies to every data page. A locking plan supports Find only
	// and requires an ungrouped, non-aggregate projection.
	Lock RowLock
	// WithExists registers a boolean existence check for each filter and
	// scope choice of an unlocked, non-aggregate plan.
	WithExists bool
}
    RowsSpec declares the finite alternatives for a single-table read. GroupBy
    lists the physical fields that determine each aggregate group.

type SQLAuthority struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    SQLAuthority verifies registered statements for a driver on behalf of one
    registry. It cannot sign SQL or change which statements that registry owns.

func (a SQLAuthority) DeniesLegacySQL() bool
    DeniesLegacySQL reports whether this credential requires registered SQL on
    its runner or Direct pool. A zero credential leaves ordinary SQL available.

func (a SQLAuthority) IsZero() bool
    IsZero reports whether this is the unset credential.

func (a SQLAuthority) Open(owner any, method CallMethod, call AuthorizedStatement) (AuthorizedSQL, error)
    Open validates a compiled call for the receiving session. Drivers pass their
    own session pointer. The returned parameters are in PostgreSQL bind order.

type SQLFiles struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    SQLFiles holds preloaded `.sql` files from an fs.FS (typically embed.FS) so
    long joins can live in dedicated files and fail at start-up when missing.

func LoadSQLFiles(fsys fs.FS, dir string) (*SQLFiles, error)
    LoadSQLFiles reads every `.sql` file under dir in fsys (recursively, keyed
    by slash-separated paths relative to dir). Empty or missing directories
    return an error.

func MustSQLFiles(fsys fs.FS, dir string) *SQLFiles
    MustSQLFiles calls LoadSQLFiles and panics on error at package
    initialization.

func (f *SQLFiles) Get(name string) string
    Get returns the SQL text for name (relative to dir) and panics if missing.

func (f *SQLFiles) Lookup(name string) (string, bool)
    Lookup returns the SQL text for name (relative to dir) if present.

func (f *SQLFiles) Names() []string
    Names returns all loaded relative file names in sorted order.

type ScalarAggregates struct {
	Max, Min, Sum, Avg []string
}
    ScalarAggregates declares the columns to verify for each PostgreSQL
    aggregate. Only listed pairs enter the definition and SQL snapshot. Runtime
    calls may still use any declared column compatible with the PostgreSQL
    function.

type Session[S any] interface {
	Scope() S
	Unscoped() bool
	Exec(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (int64, error)
	Scan(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
	Returning(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
	Each(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, decode func(func(...any) error) error) error
}
    Session executes SQL under a single fixed scope. Transaction adapters
    and Direct pools implement this interface. Each must close its cursor
    and stop on the first callback error. A session may implement ReadOnly()
    bool to decline derived writes and locking reads before any SQL is sent.
    S is the host application's row-scope value (for example a tenant, org,
    or workspace ID, or struct{} for applications without row-level scoping).

type SessionGuardConfig struct {
	VariablePrefixes           []string
	ForbidRole                 bool
	ForbidSessionAuthorization bool
	ForbidSetConfig            bool
	ForbidVariableReads        bool
}
    SessionGuardConfig selects prohibited session operations. The constructor
    copies GUC name prefixes such as "scope.", "session." and "local." and
    matches them case-insensitively. Dynamic set_config keys are rejected
    whenever a namespace is protected. ForbidVariableReads additionally
    rejects reading the protected namespaces: current_setting with a
    protected or non-literal key, SHOW of a protected name or SHOW ALL,
    and reads of the pg_settings view. A result column may be named pg_settings.
    ForbidVariableReads requires at least one VariablePrefixes entry.

type SessionKey struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    SessionKey is an opaque, unforgeable signing authority created by trusted
    application startup code (NewSessionKey). Registries configured with
    SessionKey or RequireSealed accept only sessions carrying a matching
    SessionProof signed for that exact session pointer instance.

func NewSessionKey() SessionKey
    NewSessionKey allocates a fresh, distinct SessionKey.

func (k SessionKey) IsZero() bool
    IsZero reports whether k is the unset zero SessionKey.

func (k SessionKey) Sign(owner any) SessionProof
    Sign issues a SessionProof binding k to owner. owner must be a non-nil
    pointer to a nonzero-size value; otherwise (or when k is zero) Sign returns
    the zero SessionProof.

type SessionProof struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    SessionProof records that a specific concrete session pointer was issued by
    the holder of a SessionKey. Its fields are unexported and bound to both the
    key token and the concrete owner pointer, so copying a proof onto another
    struct or wrapping a session fails verification.

type ShapeAccess struct{ Relation, Command string }
    ShapeAccess identifies one physical relation and command for policy checks.

type ShapeColumn struct {
	Relation, Name, Type string
	// TypeMod is the expected pg_attribute.atttypmod when the declaration
	// specifies a modifier. Nil requests verification of the type OID alone.
	TypeMod *int32 `json:",omitempty"`
}
    ShapeColumn records the declared PostgreSQL type of a referenced physical
    column for catalog verification. Relation is its quoted, qualified table.

type ShapeEffects uint8
    ShapeEffects describes what a compiled statement can do on its session.

const (
	// EffectRead marks a statement that observes rows.
	EffectRead ShapeEffects = 1 << iota
	// EffectWrite marks a statement that can modify data, including through a routine.
	EffectWrite
	// EffectRowLock marks a row-locking read that needs a writable transaction.
	EffectRowLock
	// EffectAdvisoryLock marks an operation whose advisory lock needs a transaction.
	EffectAdvisoryLock
)
type ShapeField struct {
	Name, Type string
	Nullable   bool
}
    ShapeField describes a result column in projection order.

type ShapeInput struct {
	Name, Type string
	Scope      bool
	// Secret requests redaction of this bind value by observers.
	Secret bool
}
    ShapeInput identifies a numbered parameter. Scope marks a parameter supplied
    by the session. Values are kept outside all snapshots.

type Slot[V any] struct {
```
